decisions.reason: Distinguishes the clipboard-text projection (draft/Occurrence, chip expanded to clipboardText) from the detect-text projection (TokenSpan verbs, chip = one U+FFFC), citing contract and facade, with plain text and separator spaces contributing normal width in both.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add, shows empty composer makes frames coincide and post-chip clipboard length overshoots detectText by length−1, insertReference returns false, and the plugin mislabels it as a changed-composer toast; explicitly rules out a real concurrent edit (revision CAS passed).

Traces remove: clipboard occurrence.offset/length passed unconverted to consumeToken, the false return is discarded, records.delete runs unconditionally — so the chip stays, dock renders unavailable from the missing record; ties both symptoms to the same coordinate mismatch, not a separate upload failure.

Derives the subtract-Σ(length−1)-for-preceding-chips mapping, applies it at both call sites (insert at draft end uses all occurrences; removal maps offset to a one-detect-character span), keeps the revision guard, and gates records deletion on a true return; concrete pseudocode with verified numbers.

T2/R1 covers two successive pastes with both chips present, T8/R7 removes a chip with preceding chips asserting joint removal of occurrence/dock/record while others survive; declined-consumption, first/last-chip and empty-again variants are also included.
